note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Location as DEPLOYED (the repo's sql/05 file is known to be out of date - never use it to check these numbers). Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. RiskType 3 = Critical. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see, with their location (CustomerBranch) and the
--         prison-term / risk flags of the Compliance master.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, c.Imprisonment, c.RiskType INTO #inst
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopedInstances(@UserID, @CustomerID) s JOIN Compliance c ON c.ID = s.ComplianceID;
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
DELETE i FROM #inst i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
WHERE cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
SELECT DISTINCT o.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #ovd
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOverdueSchedules(@CustomerID, @AsOf) o
JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = o.ComplianceInstanceID;
-- Step 4. Obligations with a performer named on the obligation itself (ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#owned') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #owned;
SELECT ComplianceInstanceID INTO #owned
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOwnership(@UserID, @CustomerID) WHERE HasInstanceOwner = 1;
-- Step 5. Every live, active location of the tenant in the entity tree (CustomerBranch: not deleted, Status = 1).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#loc') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #loc;
SELECT cb.ID AS BranchID INTO #loc FROM CustomerBranch cb JOIN dbo.tvfInsightsEntityTree(@CustomerID) t ON t.BranchID = cb.ID
WHERE cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND cb.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.Status = 1;
-- Keep the tenant id for the checks below (each check runs on its own).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tenant') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tenant;
SELECT @CustomerID AS CustomerID INTO #tenant;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
checks.tables: Steps 1-2.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Sum of all location rows
checks.tables: Obligations at a location in step 5 - equals O1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #loc l ON l.BranchID = i.BranchID;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / all obligations x 100.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: Locations in the report
checks.tables: Step 5 - every active location, with or without work.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #loc;

checks.name: Active locations of the tenant
checks.tables: CustomerBranch for this tenant, not deleted, Status = 1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM CustomerBranch WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM #tenant) AND IsDeleted = 0 AND Status = 1;

checks.name: Locations with no obligations in the period
checks.tables: Step 5 locations with nothing in steps 1-2.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #loc l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #inst i WHERE i.BranchID = l.BranchID);

checks.name: Empty end locations (no work and no active sub-locations)
checks.tables: O7 locations with no active child CustomerBranch.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #loc l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #inst i WHERE i.BranchID = l.BranchID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CustomerBranch ch WHERE ch.ParentID = l.BranchID AND ch.IsDeleted = 0 AND ch.Status = 1);

checks.name: Completed filings with a timeliness reading (all time)
checks.tables: ComplianceTransaction rows on these obligations whose status (vInsightsStatusCurrent) is a completed closure with a timeliness value.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN ComplianceTransaction t ON t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = cso.ID JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = t.StatusId
WHERE d.ClosureClass = 'completed' AND d.Timeliness IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Of those, filed on time
checks.tables: O9 where the status's timeliness is on_time.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN ComplianceTransaction t ON t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = cso.ID JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = t.StatusId
WHERE d.ClosureClass = 'completed' AND d.Timeliness = 'on_time';

checks.name: On-time rate (%)
checks.tables: O10 / O9 x 100. Blank when nothing was completed.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.Timeliness IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.Timeliness = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.Timeliness IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN ComplianceTransaction t ON t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = cso.ID JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = t.StatusId
WHERE d.ClosureClass = 'completed';

checks.name: A location's obligations
checks.tables: Steps 1-2, this CustomerBranch.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE BranchID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A location's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This location's obligations that are in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A location's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / obligations x 100, for this location.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A location's obligations with no performer on the obligation itself
checks.tables: This location's obligations not in step 4. Most still have a performer on each due date (ComplianceScheduleOn.Performerid).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey} AND w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL;

checks.name: A location's share with no performer on the obligation itself (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A location's obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1, this location.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE BranchID = {RowKey} AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A location's overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, this location.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A location's Critical-risk obligations
checks.tables: Compliance.RiskType = 3 (Critical), this location.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE BranchID = {RowKey} AND RiskType = 3;

checks.name: Performers at a location
checks.tables: Distinct ComplianceAssignment.UserID with RoleID 3 on this location's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.UserID) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey} AND ca.RoleID = 3 AND ca.UserID > 0;

checks.name: Reviewers at a location
checks.tables: Distinct ComplianceAssignment.UserID with RoleID 4 on this location's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.UserID) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey} AND ca.RoleID = 4 AND ca.UserID > 0;

checks.name: A location's completed filings, all time
checks.tables: ComplianceTransaction rows on this location's obligations whose status is a completed closure (vInsightsStatusCurrent).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN ComplianceTransaction t ON t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = cso.ID JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = t.StatusId
WHERE i.BranchID = {RowKey} AND d.ClosureClass = 'completed';

checks.name: A location's active sub-locations
checks.tables: CustomerBranch rows whose ParentID is this location, not deleted, Status = 1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM CustomerBranch WHERE ParentID = {RowKey} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND Status = 1;

checks.name: Locations depending on one performer or one reviewer
checks.tables: Locations with work where C9 or C10 is 0 or 1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (
SELECT i.BranchID FROM #inst i JOIN #loc l ON l.BranchID = i.BranchID
LEFT JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID AND ca.UserID > 0
GROUP BY i.BranchID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ca.RoleID = 3 THEN ca.UserID END) <= 1
OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ca.RoleID = 4 THEN ca.UserID END) <= 1) x;

checks.name: Locations with a possible prison term overdue
checks.tables: Locations where C7 is more than 0.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.BranchID) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.Imprisonment = 1;
